subject: Decision gates & milestone pact: HelixCare PoC runway
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@helixcare.com>, Procurement Team <procure@helixcare.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + first-draft milestone pact (HLX PoC)

Hi Sara — thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and next steps so we have alignment before we draft the MAP: 

What we heard (high level)
- Goal: evaluate Redwood inference for clinical triage assistant (throughput and latency targets are key).
- Success criteria: <10% false positive rate on triage flags in pilot; 95th p90 token latency <200ms for 2k/day baseline.
- Economic buyer: you indicated Eli Norton (SVP Product) will sign budget.
- Security/legal: Tom Bhatia and your InfoSec team will require SOC2 + data retention controls and a short questionnaire.
- Procurement timeline: target contract by end of May for June PoC start (procurement indicated a 2-week review window).

Immediate asks / next steps
1) I attached a first-draft MAP (HLX_PoC_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed gates and owners. Please review owners and milestone dates.
2) Please confirm: Eli Norton is the final approver for budget. If not, cc the right stakeholder.
3) Tom — can your team share the security questionnaire and a preferred evidence export format? If you want, I can loop our security engineer.
4) Procurement — any standard PO or redline path you prefer?

Proposed high-level milestones in the draft (full details in attachment)
- Kickoff & environment setup (Redwood demo + account provisioning) — target May 10–14
- Data ingestion & baseline run — May 17–23
- Evaluation window & quality checks — May 24–30
- Decision gate: Exec review & go/no-go — May 31

I'll follow up with an updated MAP once I have the security contact and final approver.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: HLX_PoC_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, draft milestones), briefing_notes.txt (call notes)
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@helixcare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bhatia <tbhatia@helixcare.com>, Procurement Team <procure@helixcare.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + first-draft milestone pact (HLX PoC)

Hi Marcus — appreciated the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Eli Norton is the economic approver; I will introduce you by email this week.
- Tom (cc'd) is our InfoSec lead and will own the questionnaire/evidence. Tom — we typically need an export of audit logs, data flow diagram, and retention policy. Can your team point us to the right artifacts?
- Procurement note: we use a standard Master Services Agreement and route redlines through our legal team. We target ~10 business days for initial review. I attached the procurement intake (procurement_timeline.csv) for dates on our side.

From the team: 
- Target PoC start: first week of June still looks good.
- Decision criteria: quality threshold + integration readiness (API keys, VPN access for private endpoint).

I'll take a look at the MAP and provide owner names; initial owners are correct. Please add a row for the security artifacts we need.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Lopez
Director, Clinical Product, HelixCare

Attachments: procurement_timeline.csv
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: prepping MAP updates + security evidence list

Marcus / Rachel — quick internal plan before I push updates to the customer doc: 

Actions I'll take by EOD Tuesday (May 4):
- Add a Security Evidence column to the MAP with: SOC2 report link, data flow diagram, sample audit log export (CSV), retention policy excerpt, KMS integration notes.
- Draft a short one-page security appendix (helix_security_qs_filled.pdf) that answers their questionnaire points.
- Confirm pricing bands for PoC (monthly vs metered) so Marcus can include in the decision gate materials.

Rachel — can you pull the SOC2 summary and the data flow diagram from the secure drive and drop links in the doc? I left comments in the shared link: https://redwood.app/s/HLX-POC-MAP (internal).

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@helixcare.com>, Tom Bhatia <tbhatia@helixcare.com>, Procurement Team <procure@helixcare.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + first-draft milestone pact (HLX PoC)

Hi all — thanks for the quick replies. I've incorporated the security evidence column and updated milestone dates in the MAP (attached: HLX_PoC_MAP_v1.xlsx -> v2). Highlights: 

Updated milestone schedule (short):
- May 10: Procurement kickoff (documentation exchange)
- May 12–14: Account provisioning + demo access (Redwood)
- May 17–21: Data ingestion & initial baseline run
- May 24–28: Evaluation window + quality checks
- May 31: Executive decision gate (Eli Norton invited)

Decision gates (explicit):
- Gate 1: Security sign-off (Tom) — required before production data ingestion.
- Gate 2: Baseline quality threshold (as measured by the evaluation run).
- Gate 3: Exec approval (Eli) — go/no-go.

Jordan included a one-page security appendix; Rachel added SOC2 link. Attached: HLX_PoC_MAP_v2.xlsx and helix_security_qs_filled.pdf.

Please reply with any redline or owner changes. If no objections, we'll treat this as the MAP to guide procurement and the PoC kickoff.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: HLX_PoC_MAP_v2.xlsx (updated milestones), helix_security_qs_filled.pdf (security appendix)
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@helixcare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Tom Bhatia <tbhatia@helixcare.com>, Procurement Team <procure@helixcare.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + first-draft milestone pact (HLX PoC)

Hi Marcus / team — this looks good and much easier to track. A few quick notes: 

- Tom: Security sign-off accepted in principle; we will confirm after your appendix review (target May 11).
- Procurement: please begin intake on May 10. Procurement team — I'll add Eli to the initial thread for budget approval next week.
- Timing: May 12–14 provisioning window works. If Redwood can provide an on-call engineer for the first day of ingestion, that would help speed validation.

We agree to the decision gates and milestone dates in HLX_PoC_MAP_v2.xlsx. Please provide SOW and pricing summary for the PoC scope by EOD May 7 so we can align with legal.

Thanks — Sara

Attachments referenced: HLX_PoC_MAP_v2.xlsx, helix_security_qs_filled.pdf
